:= by
  let C := 0
  have hC : ∀ (τ : UpperHalfPlane), ‖f τ‖ ≤ C :=
    by
      intro τ
      let ε : ℝ := 1
      have hε : 0 < ε := zero_lt_one
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hf_infinity ε hε
      use A
      intro z
      have hz : A ≤ z.im := hA z
      exact le_of_le_zero (le_trans hz (le_im z))
  exists C hC
